In a galaxy far, far away, the Lego Movie universe is in crisis. The evil Lord Business has taken over and the legendary Master Builders are in hiding. These Master Builders are a group of Lego minifigures with the unique ability to build anything without instructions. It is said that they meet in the "Dog" section of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss important matters.

Meanwhile, back on Earth, there is a more mundane crisis that needs attention. A project has failed, and a post-project review is necessary to understand what went wrong and to establish terms of reference for moving forward. The statement of terms of reference includes the following:

A. Understand and acknowledge what went wrong and the key lessons that must be learned.

B. Obtain all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS, and any other relevant sources.

C. Establish clear lines of accountability and responsibility for the project failure.

D. Identify the root causes of the failure and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

E. Develop a plan to implement the recommendations and monitor progress.

F. Ensure that all stakeholders are informed and involved in the review process.

G. Use the lessons learned from this review to improve future projects and prevent similar failures from occurring.
